title: BEGIN WITH THANKS
PSALM 92 MORNING PRAYER
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: golden sunrise over misty forest landscape
open window view morning sunbeam rays
calm mountain lake glowing morning dawn light
peaceful meadow bathed in early morning sunlight
sun rising over quiet pine forest valley
golden morning horizon serene ocean calm water
soft morning sunlight glowing through green trees

scenes.a: Welcome the gentle light of this beautiful new morning as you pause and open your heart.
Holy Scripture declares, It is good to give thanks to the Lord, to sing praises to your name, O Most High, to declare your steadfast love in the morning, and your faithfulness by night.
Lord, as dawn breaks today, we lift our voices in humble gratitude for your endless grace.
May your unwavering love anchor our spirits and guide our steps through every challenge today.
Fill our minds with quiet peace and illuminate our daily journey with your divine wisdom.
We praise your holy name and surrender this morning completely into your safe, loving hands.
Subscribe to join The Morning Altar for sunrise prayer.
